    Summary

    "If this is madness, then I was never sane."

    You’re the Uchiha’s best-kept secret.
    Now that the truth is out, everyone thinks they know what to do with you.
    The clan says control. The village says results.
    And someone in the dark just says, “Mine.”
    The men assigned to guard you?
    They’re really bad at their job.

    ────•⋅⊰༻♥༺⊱⋅•────

    This is a story for slow-burn addicts who want to watch emotionally constipated men get wrecked.

    It has lots of philosophical and psychological analysis (I like to pretend to be one of those tortured artist types).

    Somewhat of a reverse harem where the men have sharingans and are trying to outdo each other for your heart. Character-driven, but dick-motivated. Can’t help myself, simping is my ninja way.

    And yes, we’re gonna fuck a lot of people. But because we’re hopeless romantics, every fuck will make sense. It’ll be emotionally earned and character consistent. None of that “Itachi lets me sit on his face on the third date” shit.

    Anyway, hopefully you’ll fall in love with some dangerous men who would do anything for you. <3
